identity.note: Tier 3 identities are path-derived with filename_semantic_status UNKNOWN — a slug, not a reviewed claim. See docs/governance/SEMANTIC_FILE_IDENTITY_REPORT.md

attribution_coverage.note: Currently ~0% — attribution overlays not authored; use owner_boundary instead.

authority_coverage.note: owner_surface remains 100% UNATTRIBUTED; authority uses boundary+regime+encyclopedia relevance.

behavior_coverage.metric: ACTIVE journey steps with concept ∧ boundary resolved
behavior_coverage.note: Behavior coverage = can every declared journey step be explained by a concept and boundary? Object participation is journey_coverage on OBJs. GREEN also requires ≥7 declared steps (full candle journey depth); skeleton with 7 steps stays YELLOW even if fully resolved.

book_coverage.metric: Objects with encyclopedia phase OR book_status enrichment
book_coverage.note: Canonical Book + Encyclopedia documentation layer — strong but ≠ semantic coverage.

boundary_coverage.note: PR-5: 10 boundaries (BD-001..BD-010) with expanded globs (~94 claimed files). Spine floor still 11/11. Further seams (~30–40 target) remain for later waves.

contract_coverage.metric: Objects with config key / script registry / contract-path hint
contract_coverage.note: Heuristic contract surface — not formal MC-* seals (still OPEN).

dependency_coverage.metric: Objects with ≥1 AST import edge (imports or imported_by)
dependency_coverage.note: AST census covers src+scripts; graph.dot is corroboration only and src-scoped/stale.

evidence_coverage.note: tests_importing is AST-proven; test_text_references are TEXT_REFERENCE only.

journey_coverage.note: JN-001 full 7-step candle journey (PR-3/PR-5 BD rewiring). Object participation follows step member sets; JN-002..005 not yet authored.

physical_coverage.metric: Objects with encyclopedia enrichment / Objects on disk
physical_coverage.note: Encyclopedia is enrichment only; disk universe is denominator (848 code files today).

semantic_coverage.note: PR-4/PR-5: CN-001..CN-015 + 10 BDs with expanded globs (~93 objects with concept). YELLOW at ~11%. Further CN (~50 target) and BD waves raise this; object join is member-driven, not concept-count-driven.
